description:
You do not need 27 AI subscriptions to run an AI-enabled funding agency. You need *5 core AI tools for loan brokers* working together.

👉 *See all 27 AI tools for loan brokers:*
https://www.distilledfunding.com/post/ai-tools-for-loan-brokers

In this video, I break down the lean starter stack for business loan brokers, commercial funding professionals, and funding agencies:

• *AI Assistant* — ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini for research, borrower prep, drafting, and workflow design
• *CRM* — HubSpot or a similar platform for leads, deal stages, tasks, and follow-up
• *Meeting Intelligence* — Fireflies.ai for recording, transcription, summaries, and next actions
• *Automation* — Zapier, Make, or n8n to connect your funding workflow
• *Knowledge System* — Notion or Airtable for lender data, SOPs, templates, and operational knowledge

The goal is not to collect software.

Start with the funding workflow: _Lead → Intake → Qualification → Documents → Lender Fit → Submission → Follow-Up → Close → Referral._

Then automate the repetitive work that consumes expensive human attention.

*Machine handles repetition. Human handles consequence.*

If you run a funding agency or work as a loan broker, comment below: *What part of your funding workflow wastes the most time right now?*
